title: Low Quantity Single Strand CAGE Protocol
author: Hazuki Takahashi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bbwkipcw
materials: Reverse Transcription (RT) to generate RNA/cDNA hybrids
to read sequence information of cDNA Read

steps.title: Reverse Transcription (ssCAGE - High Quantity)
steps.instruction: Perform reverse transcription for RNA amounts > 1 µg (example for 5 µg starting RNA).

substeps.instruction: Mix 5 µL of RNAs (1 µg/µL), 1 µL of RT primer (N6+TCT), and 4 µL of RNase free water.
Incubate the mix at 65 °C for 5 min, then immediately place on ice for 2 min.
Add 4 µL 5x First-Strand buffer, 1 µL 10 mM dNTPs, 1 µL 0.1 M DTT, 2 µL RNase free water, and 2 µL SuperScript III Reverse Transcriptase; mix by pipetting on ice.
Incubate the 20 µL solution at 25 °C for 30 sec, 55 °C for 30 min, and then keep at 4 °C.
Purify RNA/cDNA hybrids: Add 36 µL (1.8-folds) RNACleanXP beads, incubate at room temperature for 5 min, spin down, and set on magnetic bar for 5 min.
Discard supernatant, wash beads with 200 µL 70% EtOH, set on magnetic bar for 5 min, and discard supernatant. Repeat wash once.
Discard 70% EtOH completely, add 42 µL RNase free water, and mix extensively (> 60 times) to elute.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 min, spin down, set on magnetic bar for 5 min, and transfer supernatant (~ 40 µL) to a new tube.

steps.title: Reverse Transcription (LQ-ssCAGE - Low Quantity)
steps.instruction: Perform reverse transcription for RNA amounts < 1 µg (target 25 ng to 100 ng per tube).

substeps.instruction: Mix 4 µL of 50 ng RNAs (12.5 ng/µL) and 1 µL of 1.25 mM barcoded RT primer in a 96-well plate.
Incubate at 65 °C for 5 min, then immediately place on ice for 2 min.
Prepare enzyme mix on ice: 2.0 µL 5x First Strand buffer, 0.5 µL 0.1 M DTT, 0.5 µL 10 mM dNTPs, 1.0 µL RNase free water, and 1.0 µL SuperScript III Reverse Transcriptase (Total 5.0 µL).
Add 5 µL of enzyme mix to the RNA/primer mix and mix 10 times by pipetting on ice.
Incubate at 25 °C for 30 sec, 50 °C for 30 min, and keep at 4 °C.
Pool samples: Transfer 10 µL of hybrids from each sample to a 1.5 mL tube (e.g., 48 samples = 480 µL).
Recover remaining molecules: Use 15 µL RNase free water to wash the 96-well plate in 8-well increments, transferring the wash to the 1.5 mL tube (total volume ~ 600 µL).
Vortex the 600 µL solution, spin down, and aliquot into three 1.5 mL tubes (200 µL each).
Purify pooled hybrids: Add 300 µL (1.8-folds) RNACleanXP beads to a 200 µL aliquot, mix, and incubate at room temperature for 10 min.
Spin down, set on magnetic bar for 5 min, discard supernatant, and wash twice with 1.2 mL 70% EtOH (5 min on magnet per wash).
Discard EtOH, add 100 µL RNase free water, mix > 60 times, incubate at room temperature for 5 min, spin down, and set on magnetic bar for 5 min.
Transfer 100 µL supernatant to a new tube. Repeat elution twice for a final volume of 200 µL.
Concentrate the 200 µL solution to ~ 40 µL using a SpeedVac at 37 °C (approx. 2 h). Pool solutions from the three tubes and concentrate the final volume to 40 µL at 37 °C. Do not dry completely.

steps.title: Oxidation of Cap Structure
steps.instruction: Modify the diol group of the cap structure.

substeps.instruction: Mix 40 µL of RNA/cDNA hybrid, 2 µL of 1 M NaOAc (pH 4.5), and 2 µL of 250 mM NaIO4 by pipetting 10 times.
Incubate for 5 min on ice, wrapped in aluminum foil to protect from light.
Add 16 µL of 1 M Tris-HCl (pH 8.5) to neutralize and mix well.

steps.title: Purification of Oxidized Hybrids
steps.instruction: Purify the oxidized RNA/cDNA hybrids using magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 108 µL (1.8-folds) RNACleanXP beads to 60 µL of oxidized hybrid and mix.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 min, spin down, and set on magnetic bar for 5 min.
Discard supernatant, wash twice with 200 µL 70% EtOH, and discard EtOH completely.
Add 42 µL RNase free water, mix > 60 times, incubate at room temperature for 5 min, spin down, and set on magnetic bar for 5 min.
Collect 40 µL of supernatant into a new tube.

steps.title: Biotinylation
steps.instruction: Couple biotin to the oxidized RNA/cDNA hybrids.

substeps.instruction: Mix 40 µL of purified oxidized hybrid, 4 µL of 1 M NaOAc (pH 6.3), and 4 µL of 100 mM Biotin (long arm) hydrazide by pipetting 10 times.
Incubate for 30 min at 40 °C.
Add 86.4 µL (1.8-folds) RNACleanXP beads to the 44 µL solution and purify following the steps in the 'Purification of Oxidized Hybrids' section.

steps.title: RNaseONE Digestion
steps.instruction: Digest the RNA component of the RNA/cDNA hybrids.

substeps.instruction: Add 4.5 µL of 10x RNaseONE buffer and 0.5 µL of RNaseONE to 40 µL of purified biotinylated hybrids; mix 10 times.
Incubate for 30 min at 37 °C.
Add 81 µL (1.8-folds) RNACleanXP beads and purify following the steps in the 'Purification of Oxidized Hybrids' section.
Add 30 µL Dynabeads M-270 Streptavidin to a tube, set on magnetic bar for 5 min, and discard supernatant.
Wash the beads three times with 30 µL LiCl buffer, discarding supernatant each time.
Resuspend the final beads in 35 µL LiCl buffer.

steps.title: CapTrap Reaction
steps.instruction: Capture and release the capped cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 35 µL of prepared beads to 40 µL of RNA/cDNA hybrids and mix.
Incubate for 15 min at 37 °C, mixing by pipetting at the 7-min mark.
Spin down, set on magnetic bar for 2 min, and discard supernatant.
Wash three times: add 150 µL TE wash buffer, mix 60 times, spin down, set on magnetic bar for 2 min, and discard supernatant.
Add 35 µL Release buffer, mix 60 times, incubate at 95 °C for 5 min, then on ice for 1 min.
Spin down, set on magnetic bar for 2 min, and transfer the supernatant to a new 16-well plate.
Add an additional 30 µL Release buffer to the beads, mix, spin down, set on magnetic bar for 2 min, and transfer the 30 µL supernatant to the same tube.

steps.title: RNaseONE and RNaseH Treatment
steps.instruction: Remove remaining RNAs from the CapTrapped cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 2.9 µL release buffer, 2 µL RNaseONE, and 0.1 µL RNase H to 30 µL of CapTrapped cDNA; mix 10 times.
Incubate at 37 °C for 30 min.
Add 126 µL (1.8-folds) AMPureXP beads to 33 µL of the solution and purify following the 'Purification of Oxidized Hybrids' steps.
Dry 40 µL of purified cDNA using a SpeedVac at 37 °C for ~ 75 min.
Resuspend the pellet in 4 µL RNase free water.

steps.title: 5' Single Strand Linker Ligation
steps.instruction: Ligate the 5' linker to the cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Incubate 4 µL of cDNA at 95 °C for 5 min, then on ice for 2 min.
Incubate 4 µL of 5' linker at 55 °C for 5 min, then on ice for 2 min.
Mix 4 µL of 5' linker, 4 µL of cDNA, and 16 µL of Mighty Mix (Total 24 µL).
Incubate at 16 °C for 16 h (overnight).
Add 46 µL RNase free water and 126 µL (1.8-folds) AMPureXP beads to 24 µL of cDNA and mix.
Purify following the 'Purification of Oxidized Hybrids' steps.
Heat inactivate: Incubate at 95 °C for 5 min, then on ice for 2 min.
Add 48 µL (1.2-folds) AMPureXP beads to 40 µL of cDNA and repeat the purification steps.
Dry 40 µL of cDNA using a SpeedVac at 80 °C for ~ 35 min.
Resuspend the pellet in 4 µL RNase free water.

steps.title: 3' Single Strand Linker Ligation
steps.instruction: Ligate the 3' linker to the cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Incubate 4 µL of cDNA at 95 °C for 5 min, then on ice for 2 min.
Incubate 4 µL of 3' linker at 65 °C for 5 min, then on ice for 2 min.
Mix 4 µL of 3' linker, 4 µL of cDNA, and 16 µL of Mighty Mix.
Incubate at 30 °C for 4 h.
Purify the solution following the steps described in the 5' Linker Purification section (steps a-f).
Dissolve the final pellet in 10 µL of RNase, DNase-free water.

steps.title: Library QC
steps.instruction: Quantify the library concentration using the KAPA Library Quantification Kit.

steps.title: Sequencing Preparation
steps.instruction: Denature and dilute the library for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Mix X µL Library (2250 amol), (19-X) µL RNase, DNase-free water, and 1 µL 2N NaOH (Total 20 µL).
Incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Place on ice and add 20 µL of pre-chilled 1 M Tris-HCl (pH 7.0) to neutralize.
Add 110 µL of HT1 buffer.
Transfer 120 µL of the solution to HiSeq2500.
